question: T0 coherent requires 857 source-time link cuts, T1 pairwise/coherent 858: do the two conditional input scenarios cut the SAME adjacent record links, or do totals conceal different break positions?

frozen_two_arms.A: T0_FULL_DAY_UNCERTAINTY coherent forward interval minimum breaks: 857

method: Build cut index sets with the frozen source-blind T0 chronological order within each animal-season group. Compare the same within-group adjacent record ordinal edges under both source clock scenarios without generating external GPS coordinates or individual timestamps.
metrics: number of links cut by both A and B
Jaccard coefficient of cuts, and of retained edges, with fixed shared denominator
number of dependent animal-season groups with any A vs B cut disagreement
counts of T0-only and T1-only cuts conditional on prior T0 pair status (robust/contingent/excluded)
verify A cuts 857, B cuts 858, source groups 421 and link denominator 28532
constraints: no ID/time/coordinate samples or per-animal reports in output
no withheld 2h GPS, geometry, movement model, prediction score or threshold tuning
do not treat similar or identical cut masks as proof of correct source clock or realized Brownian bridge path
retain historical original source clock/CRS STOP and existing EOG-WF 3/31/3
interpretation: Overlap is conditional on the frozen source representation and two hypothetical clock windows, not a prospective biological validation.
